candidates.title: Fail-Closed Lowering of Resident KV Claims onto LLM Serving Runtimes
candidates.reason: Examines concrete KV retention/offload primitives in TensorRT-LLM, SGLang/HiCache, Dynamo and patched vLLM, providing a runtime-semantics view complementary to performance-centric cache work.
